entries.title: Senate Majority Leader files cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 3633, the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act
entries.facts: The U.S. Senate Daily Press Gallery floor log for the legislative day of Friday, August 7, 2026 - a session that ran into the early hours of Saturday, August 8 - records at 4:52 a.m. that Majority Leader Thune filed cloture on the nomination of Matthew R. Byrne to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio, and then filed cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 3633, Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. The same log records at 4:46 a.m. that the Senate stands adjourned until 3:00 p.m. on Monday, September 14, 2026, that following Leader Remarks the Senate will be in a period of morning business, and that at 5:30 p.m. cloture will ripen on the Byrne nomination. The log records no vote on H.R. 3633, and states no date or time for a cloture vote on the motion to proceed to H.R. 3633.
